summary.text: Jeremiah Fredrickson is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 92, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Clint Moses.

paragraphs.text: Jeremiah Fredrickson defeated Melvin Marin in the Democratic primary for Wisconsin State Assembly District 92 on August 11, 2026, with 79.2% of the vote.
Ballotpedia lists the Wisconsin State AFL-CIO among the organizations that endorsed him.
